section.title: Cool Down Activity
section.para: An art museum opens at 9 a.m. and closes at 5 p.m. The function \(V\) gives the number of visitors in the museum \(h\) hours after it opens.

div.para: An hour and 15 minutes after the museum opened (at 10:15 a.m.), there were 28 visitors in the building.

list.item: Explain what this statement tells us about the situation: \(V(1.25) = 28\).

Use function notation to represent each statement:
At 1 p.m., there were 257 visitors in the museum.
At the time of closing, there were no visitors in the museum.
Use the previous statements about the visitors in the museum to sketch a graph that could represent the function.

problem.para: When you have finished graphing, select the solution button to compare your work.

image.alt: Function. hours after opening time and number of visitors.

solution.para: Your graph should show points at \((1.25,28)\) and \((4,257)\), with or without lines connecting these points.
